constants.FILTER_ACTIVE_REGION: AND s.region_cd IN (SELECT r.region_cd FROM D_REGION r WHERE r.active_flg = 'Y')

SalesChartRepository.getRevenueBySegment.sql: SELECT s.customer_segment, SUM(s.net_revenue_amt) AS revenue, SUM(s.order_cnt) AS orders FROM F_SALES_SUMMARY s WHERE s.sale_dt BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND s.region_cd IN (SELECT r.region_cd FROM D_REGION r WHERE r.active_flg = 'Y') GROUP BY s.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

SalesChartRepository.getTopCities.sql: SELECT s.city_nm, SUM(s.net_revenue_amt) AS revenue FROM F_SALES_SUMMARY s WHERE s.sale_dt BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND s.region_cd IN (SELECT r.region_cd FROM D_REGION r WHERE r.active_flg = 'Y') GROUP BY s.city_nm ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
